Kat Macdonald is a London-based sound and media artist exploring collective practice, embodiment and technology. She is the founder of the London Community Laptop Orchestra.

Her work uses pedagogy, open scoring and collective activations as a method to draw attention to social systems and infrastructures that lie unacknowledged in everyday life.

updates

⚇ noisy spaces @ peckham digital ( October 2026 ) ⚇

I performed a rendition of Noisy Spaces at Peckham Digital 2026! Photo by Hayley Jay.


⚇ time to listen ( October 2026 ) ⚇

While part of the visiting program for Ensemblefest, I brought a short talk and presentation of LCLO at the Time To Listen conference in Berlin, hosted by Field Notes Berlin.


⚇ i miss the internet ( September 2026 ) ⚇

I presented the warm up piece from the London Community Laptop Orchestra at the Photographers Gallery as part of Error 417 Foundations “i miss the internet” event. (photos by Carmen Gray)
